docs.title: Architecture
docs.lede: Cryo sits between Apache Iceberg catalogs on the read side and engines on the write side. Sources never reach destinations without going through the plan.

docs.title: How Cryo fits

headings.text: Scan path — metadata only, no live data files

docs.lede: A source answers where an Apache Iceberg table lives. A destination answers where maintenance runs. Cryo holds the plan, admission, locks, and evidence between them.

docs.title: Deployment

headings.text: A small control plane, plus the engines you already run.

docs.lede: Cryo does not replace Trino or Apache Spark. It plans maintenance and admits that work to the engines you already run. Deploy as a Helm chart; keep your engines where they are.

docs.title: Engines

headings.text: The same operation, side by side

docs.lede: The planner is engine-agnostic. Trino SQL and Spark SQL are rendered apart. The same plan produces different SQL, never different intent.

docs.title: Health and cost

headings.text: A grade is a score with the deductions still attached.
Projection path — scanner to stored cost

docs.lede: The Scanner grades a table from stored metadata. It does not scan data files on the request path. Object storage is not an input.

docs.title: Cryo — Apache Iceberg maintenance, with receipts

headings.text: Make every Iceberg table easier to run .
Four answers before the next run.
Read stays apart from write. By design.
Charts for decisions, receipts for trust.
A real lake in four commands.

docs.lede: Cryo reads your catalogs, plans maintenance, and admits the work to Trino or Spark — without ever coupling the two. Every run leaves a receipt.

docs.title: Maintenance
docs.lede: A maintenance run on an Apache Iceberg table compacts first, then cleans up, in one fixed order. The order is defined in code; no preset can change it.

docs.title: Quickstart

headings.text: A local lake, then a scan.

docs.lede: Requires Docker, Python 3.12+, and Node 22+. Clone, start, seed, and open the UI. The demo catalog has intentional maintenance issues so you can see Cryo work.

docs.title: Reference
docs.lede: Cryo is an Apache-2.0, self-hosted Apache Iceberg maintenance platform. This page lists what is in the box and what is not.
